title: Abstract: The US Government & The Iran Case, January 1, 1978
doc_notes: This is an archival record from the NARA UAP collection containing a verbatim wire message regarding a 1976 military encounter in Iran.

encounters.summary: Iranian Air Force F-4 jets intercepted a UFO that caused electronic and weapons system failure, released smaller objects, and appeared to land on a dry lake bed.
encounters.entity_appearance: Primary object had flashing strobe lights in rectangular pattern; secondary object was half to one third the size of the moon; third object was cylinder shaped.
encounters.entity_behavior: Played cat and mouse, paralyzed electronics, released smaller objects, landed on earth.
encounters.quote: The object and the pursuing F-4 continued on a course to the south of Tehran
